The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a bodypart the can be removed at the [[preparation place]] and will have the effect of removing <span style = "display:inline-block;">{{Skull|white}}{{Skull|white}}</span>, <span style = "display:inline-block;">{{Skull|white}}{{Skull|red}}</span>, or <span style = "display:inline-block;">{{Skull|red}}{{Skull|red}}</span> chosen randomly from the corpses rating.  See the [[corpses]] page for more information on corpse rating and the effects of the various operations or the [[preparation place]] workstation page for the list of other body parts that can be removed there. Studying {{PAGENAME}} at the [[Study table]] will give you {{Techpoint|Blue|50}}.

A standard heart will always have random stats of 1-3 {{Skull|white}}'s and/or 1-3 {{Skull|red}}'s these stats are initially hidden. Later, the [[Inquisitor]] will teach you how to see the exact stats in addition to a chance to find a [[Dark heart]].
